title: init_db() only called under __main__, not in create_app()
evidence: app.py:189 `app = create_app()` builds the module-level app without creating the table; init_db() is invoked only at app.py:192 inside the `if __name__ == '__main__'` block
suggestion: Call init_db(db_path) inside create_app() so a WSGI deployment (gunicorn app:app) auto-creates the schema; tests pass only because the fixture calls init_db() explicitly (test_app.py:11)

title: Validation is thorough beyond the spec
evidence: app.py:67 parse_book_payload rejects non-JSON bodies (app.py:113), empty/whitespace title/author (app.py:82), non-int year including bool (app.py:88), and empty isbn (app.py:94)
suggestion: No action — exceeds R9 which only required title/author presence

title: 17 tests vs the 3 required (R12)
evidence: test_app.py defines 17 test functions covering health, CRUD, author filter, partial PUT, 404s, and validation edge cases; test_coverage=0.97 in scores.json
suggestion: No action — well exceeds the minimum
